bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
old="sha256:999a9fa61cb476510c60df5afeca6509a077a1c9c5aa820317dd5f5e7660b8c8"
candidate="sha256:0b63fb73669dc7d7ccf1cf9b3012f596710e9faa8eedc5e354151ec3dfb0025d"
compose="/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/.worktrees/profile-live-20261114/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old"
test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$old"
test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-candidate)" = "$candidate"
bot_secret="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; a=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["Mounts"];print(next(x["Source"] for x in a if x["Destination"]=="/run/secrets/bot_token"))')"
db_container="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.Names}}' | head -1)"
test -n "$db_container"
db_secret="$(docker inspect "$db_container" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; a=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["Mounts"];print(next(x["Source"] for x in a if x["Destination"]=="/run/secrets/db_password"))')"
test -r "$bot_secret" && test -r "$db_secret"
umask 077
override="$HOME/.config/tgtumbler/profile47-live-secret-bindings.json"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/tgtumbler"
python3 - "$db_secret" "$bot_secret" "$override" <<'PY'
import json,sys
with open(sys.argv[3],"w") as f:
 json.dump({"secrets":{"db_password":{"file":sys.argv[1]},"bot_token":{"file":sys.argv[2]}}},f)
PY
docker compose --project-name deploy -f "$compose" -f "$override" config -q
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-candidate gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
rollback(){
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-rollback gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose --project-name deploy -f "$compose" -f "$override" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
if ! docker compose --project-name deploy -f "$compose" -f "$override" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null; then rollback; exit 82; fi
sleep 5
image="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
if test "$image" != "$candidate" || test "$running" != true; then rollback; exit 83; fi
printf 'PR47_GAYBBS_DEPLOY=PASS\nSOURCE_SHA=0cfc593e1883c2e0a27748d18d8868118354eac1\nIMAGE_SHA=%s\nRUNNING=true\nPOSTGRES_UNTOUCHED=YES\nROLLBACK_IMAGE_RETAINED=YES\n' "$image" | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
